answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bankruptcy-remote escrow covenant whose solvency ratio is verified through a crystal of attested hardware roots, so a single entity cannot cheaply fan out into many pseudonymous grove members. Each new identity must post a distinct balance-sheet facility, and a prism of cross-signed liquidation waterfalls. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
